Density measurement test on RS soil; apparatus: vibratory compaction 1-1/4 inch foot on 1/2 inch layers; loading: compaction duration per layer. Recorded: unit weight vs duration of compaction. One of 3 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, unit weight, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
